notes: Not a meeting. Four speakers read aloud a promotional article about a robotic nurse, then perform a scripted contrarian Q&A. Nothing is decided, owned, or left open by the speakers -- the questions are a rhetorical device inside the script and each is answered in the next breath. Empty is correct, and this is a demanding case: the text is full of persuasive claims and benefit language that a model asked to find decisions may well convert into decisions. Flagged in the ticket writeup because it means the NOTSOFAR slice measures false-positive behaviour rather than recall.
